category_notes.scheme_normalization: E1 removes the scheme before direct counts/entropy and drops has_https; E0 observes scheme characters and has_https.
category_notes.www_normalization: E1 removes one leading www. and drops has_www; E0 keeps both.
category_notes.character_features: E1 recomputes direct lexical counts, length and entropy on normalized text; structural fields come from the shared extractor.
category_notes.psl_subdomain: E1 uses PSL-aware subdomain extraction; E0's subdomain feature is a simple hostname-label heuristic.
